description: This file defines classes and constants for managing Chromium protocol connections and sessions within the Playwright testing framework, including CRConnection, CRSession, and CDPSession classes.

classes.name: CRConnection
classes.description: Manages a connection to a Chromium remote debugging protocol, handling message sending, receiving, and session management.

classes.name: CRSession
classes.description: Represents a session within a CRConnection, allowing command execution and event handling for a specific target.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: A higher-level session class for interacting with Chrome DevTools Protocol targets, supporting attach/detach and event handling.

methods.name: _rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message with a specific session ID, method, and parameters.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol responses and routes them to the appropriate session or event handler.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, cleaning up sessions and emitting disconnect events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection if not already closed.

methods.name: createBrowserSession
methods.description: Creates a new browser session by attaching to the browser target.

methods.name: createChildSession
methods.description: Creates a child session within a CRSession.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a protocol command within a CRSession.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the session from its target.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: attachToTarget
methods.description: Attaches to a specific target and returns a new CDPSession.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles the closure of a CDPSession.
